# Sarvesh Talele

> AI Engineer at Tata Consultancy Services and Claude Certified Architect (Foundations and Professional, Anthropic). Builds agentic AI systems, MCP servers, multi-agent workflows, Graph-RAG pipelines, and secure enterprise LLM infrastructure. Writes Sarvesh's AI Newsletter. Every page on this site is generated from Markdown/MDX.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://sarveshtalele.org/): Andromeda Voyage, an interactive story of my work: credentials, impact metrics, how I work, pinned projects, newsletter, podcast, Claude Prep, journey.
- [Dashboard](https://sarveshtalele.org/dashboard): Evidence-backed engineering metrics (each links to its proof), GitHub statistics from the GitHub API, verified credentials and research.
- [Projects](https://sarveshtalele.org/projects): Every public GitHub repository with stars, forks, language, and categories (Agentic AI, MCP, RAG, Claude Skills, Claude Code, Machine Learning, Developer Tools).
- [Newsletter](https://sarveshtalele.org/newsletter): Sarvesh's AI Newsletter. Plain-English articles on Claude, AI agents, MCP, and careers in AI. Archive: https://sarveshtalele.org/newsletter/archive · Products: https://sarveshtalele.org/newsletter/products
- [References](https://sarveshtalele.org/references): Podcasts, talks, LinkedIn posts, and articles published elsewhere.
- [Claude](https://sarveshtalele.org/claude): Claude Certified Architect badges, study guides, and free practice tools.
- [CCAR-F Mock Exam](https://sarveshtalele.org/claude/quiz): Free timed 60-question mock exam for the Claude Certified Architect, Foundations exam (unofficial, not affiliated with Anthropic).
- [Learn & Review](https://sarveshtalele.org/claude/review): 360 original CCAR-F practice questions grouped by domain and task statement, each with explanations and the Claude documentation page to read. Also as PDFs: https://sarveshtalele.org/claude/downloads/ccar-f-practice-questions-study.pdf and https://sarveshtalele.org/claude/downloads/ccar-f-practice-questions-practice.pdf
- [Foundations exam guide](https://sarveshtalele.org/claude/foundations): CCAR-F blueprint, five domains, six scenarios, mental model, and study plan.
- [About](https://sarveshtalele.org/about): Background story, skills, credentials, education, achievements.
- [Experience](https://sarveshtalele.org/experience), [Certifications](https://sarveshtalele.org/certifications), [Publications](https://sarveshtalele.org/publications), [Contact](https://sarveshtalele.org/contact)
